tidbit: Did you know… about 16,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A crypto exploit led to the return of 3.8M dollars. Reported by Tekedia: the incident connects to alleged Nvidia chip smuggling valued at 300M dollars that raises security concerns.
Mistral launches Chonk, an open-weight artificial intelligence model trained on 160 languages. Reported by Courthouse News: the model was trained using 4,000 Nvidia chips as part of France's sovereign artificial intelligence push.
Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT. Reported by OpenAI: the firm uses the platform to advance its quantitative research capabilities.
Nvidia launches the GeForce RTX 4070 graphics card with DLSS 3 technology. Reported by Kotaworld: the new card is priced at 669 euros and includes new gaming tools.
Nvidia partners with six Wall Street financial firms to raise 500 billion dollars for artificial intelligence infrastructure. Reported by Crypto Briefing: the financing approach uses graphics processing unit backed financing to unlock capital for artificial intelligence hardware.
Free every hour.
